correctness.rationale: For every pair, local smaller-load assignment inductively bounds its signed difference by largest item assigned to each endpoint. Exact load-minus-share equals half the sum of signed pair discrepancies. With at most two distinct neighboring agents, the sum of two endpoint maxima is bounded by twice the single largest item received or missed. This proves both Prop1 forms at every prefix for arbitrary positive real item sizes. The unit degree-three tournament verifies the sharp boundary. The checker tested 55987+271453 exhaustive cases, 10000 random cases and all 128 adaptive paths.

value.rationale: A natural graph-structural distinction (disjoint paths/cycles versus possible branching) sharply determines when exact online Prop1 can hold for arbitrary weights. The same irrevocable rule simultaneously certifies both goods and chores at every prefix and tolerates infinitely many possible pair-item types/horizons; this extends beyond previously treated offline, unit-size or two-type cases, while a known three-partner obstruction shows the degree threshold matters.
